title: Approximate tangent plane at a point of local finiteness gives a bounded density ratio (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(3))
statement: Let S ⊆ ℝ^Q, y ∈ ℝ^Q and T a linear subspace of ℝ^Q such that T is the (unweighted, Def. 1.4) approximate tangent space of S at y, and suppose Hⁿ(S ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ for some r > 0. Then there is K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that Hⁿ(S ∩ B̄_ρ(y)) ≤ K · ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) for all sufficiently small ρ > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl Q)) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (S ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞) → ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (S ∩ closedBall y ρ) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
